summaryForNext: 5 changes in 2 rounds. Round 1 (sequenced first, unblocks verification): fix-root-frontend-script-invocation -- swap `pnpm --filter ./frontend <cmd>` for `pnpm -C frontend <cmd>` in build/dev/test/test:e2e/lint/typecheck; format's `exec prettier` sub-case needs separate verification (prettier is a root devDependency, not hoisted into frontend/node_modules under -C -- try `pnpm exec prettier --write frontend/src/` from root with no -C/--filter at all as the simplest fix). Do NOT add a root-level pnpm-workspace.yaml `packages:` entry for frontend -- confirmed during assess to break the entity-mgmt submodule's own nested workspace resolution. First change to apply: fix-root-frontend-script-invocation.
